item.title: New Beginnings
item.description:
My website has been through many versions. Until recently it was even completely offline for a while. I had to self-host it on a Raspberry Pi 4 because Synapse1 needed to use the domain name as well. Then I had the port forwarding off for a while because I wasn’t ready to start it up. Now it’s back to running on GitHub Pages2 again.

I wasn’t happy with any of the previous versions of the website I’d produced. They had quite poor layouts and designs, and I didn’t feel like they expressed myself correctly. I also tried experimenting with Next.js3, but I decided I wanted to stick to a single minimalistic site that also included my blog. So I’ve gone back to using the static site generator Hugo4 and I set up a theme that suits me best.
